title: Repeatable GPS malfunctions on the ranch

tellings.quote: >> supporting GPS malfunctions and is manipulated on Skinwalker Ranch. It just does not operate.

plain: Brandon Fugal owns Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that GPS, the satellite system that tells devices where they are, repeatedly malfunctions or gets manipulated on the ranch and sometimes just does not work. He sees this as a sign that something on the land is interfering with technology.
